sections.title: Change board
sections.sql: select name as change,number as part,code as revision,author as owner,due,status,reviewer from change_board order by due

sections.title: Release gaps
sections.sql: select number as part,code as revision,gap from release_gaps order by number

sections.title: Component status
sections.sql: select * from component_usage order by assembly

sections.title: Released revisions
sections.sql: select number,name,code,purpose,test_evidence,use_instructions from revision_register where status='released' order by number
